captions.instagram:
BUILT® in one swipe: an AI-powered, robotics-driven, cloud-based, laser-guided system for producing prefabricated modular housing.

The model: one mother factory in the United States and hundreds of custom pilot factories in the countries that need housing, designed for local jobs and government partnerships.

We unveiled it in August 2026, and I presented it at the United Nations.

#BUILT #ModularConstruction #Housing

captions.linkedin:
Our mission at JemRock is to change how the world produces housing at global scale. BUILT® is how we plan to do it.

BUILT® is an AI-powered, robotics-driven, cloud-based, laser-guided prefabricated modular housing production system. The model is one mother factory in the United States and hundreds of custom pilot factories in the countries that need housing.

It is designed for local jobs and government partnerships, millimeter and sub-millimeter precision, and less material waste. We unveiled it in August 2026, and I presented it at the United Nations.

#ConstructionTech #Housing

What question would you ask first?
